caption:
A rule-breaking trade that wins is more dangerous than a good trade that loses. It teaches you the wrong lesson.
Even a 55% win rate has about a 92% chance of 4 or more losses in a row somewhere in 100 trades. Streaks are normal, not a verdict.
Judge yourself on whether you followed the plan, then close the charts and go live your life.

Education only. Not financial advice.

#CandleAndCode #TheLongGame #TradingPsychology #ProcessOverOutcome #RiskManagement
